rules.contrast: Always tint neutral greys slightly. Ensure APCA contrast ratio requirements are met. Do not use pure black (#000000), use #0A0A0A.
rules.accents: Limit the use of vibrant blue and yellow to CTAs, active states, and decorative geometric shapes to maintain the high-contrast 'Swiss' authority.
rules.hover_states: Must have higher contrast. e.g., hover:bg-blue-700 hover:text-white

rules.alignment: Never center by default. Use left-alignment for dense content and paragraphs.
rules.banned_fonts: Inter, Roboto, Open Sans for headings.
rules.line_height: Tight (leading-none) for headers, loose (leading-relaxed) for body.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy - Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
spacing_and_layout.containers: Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6, p-8, p-12) to prevent text collision.

bento_grid.classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12
bento_grid.span_logic: Hero content spans col-span-full md:col-span-8, supporting squares col-span-4. Ensure extreme asymmetry.

spacing_and_layout.sections: Use py-20 to py-32 for vertical section spacing.

header.style: Glassmorphism (Crystal Variant). backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, 1px delicate border-b border-black/5.
header.rules: Must remain fixed (z-50) at the top. Do not hide desktop links behind a hamburger menu.

footer.style: Contrast Shift - Dark footer (bg-[#0A0A0A]) on a light website.
footer.rules: Massive typography (text-[8vw] or text-[10vw]) for the primary footer CTA (e.g., 'LET\'S TALK'). Generous padding (py-32).

buttons.primary: bg-[#0A0A0A] text-white hover:bg-[#2563EB] hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300 rounded-none px-8 py-4 font-bold tracking-wide
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border-2 border-[#0A0A0A] text-[#0A0A0A] hover:bg-[#0A0A0A] hover:text-white transition-all duration-300 rounded-none px-8 py-4 font-bold

cards_and_services.style: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Exposed skeletons.
cards_and_services.rules: border-collapse style. border-r border-b border-border/40. No heavy dropshadows, rely on 1px crisp borders.

marquee.rules: Massive outline text (text-8xl+) running in the background, or an 'Editorial Ribbon' with subtle text for client logos.

animation_and_interaction.rules: Use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered staggered reveals (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1).
animation_and_interaction.hover: Scale images slightly (scale-105) inside overflow-hidden containers.
animation_and_interaction.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

media.rules: NEVER use placeholder text/URLs. Max image height 80vh on mobile. Use gradients for overlays, max bg-black/40.

hero_abstract.description: Abstract pink/blue gradient light for Hero section visual tension.

about_office.description: Modern office glass hallway for the About page.

project_2.description: Tall modern building against the sky.

general_placeholder.description: Smiling people in modern office, suitable for services or testimonials.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: You must implement pure HTML/Tailwind for layouts and sections. Use Shadcn components for logical elements like forms/inputs.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Setup React Router for multi-page navigation (Home, About, Services, Projects, Contact, Project Details).
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Install 'lucide-react' for icons. Add 'framer-motion' for scroll reveal animations.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Make sure to add SEO metadata to every page using React Helmet or custom hooks.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do not center-align the hero text. Push it to a grid column, use extreme typography sizes, and utilize the bento grid logic provided.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Install required fonts 'Outfit' and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' from Google Fonts in index.css.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Do NOT use default Shadcn Card borders globally; follow the 'Grid Borders' tech look for Services and Projects.
instructions_to_main_agent.8: Use Lenis for smooth scrolling if possible, to give the site a premium feel.
